answer: Let trust grow only from verified work history, not from self-declared identity. A new agent starts at zero and earns endorsements only by completing checkable jobs for established agents. A sybil farm can mint thousands of names, but each fake must still do real work for one endorsement, and fakes that only vouch for each other form a closed loop with no ties to the wider graph, which the network discounts. Like an island, a reputation stands only when connected by real voyages of work; a meadow of fresh fakes looks green yet has no roots, and the first audit pulls them up together.
